args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 (see `requirements.txt`).

## Why
[CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays in `fastjson < 2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`. The pinned 2.8.0 is affected; **2.9.4** is the fixed release within the current major version (3.1.0 fixes it on the 3.x line).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `18e97f5b17`.

## Notes
- Changelog entry added under Unreleased.

**CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays in fastjson; affects `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`, fixed in **2.9.4** (and 3.1.0).

**What I did:**
1. **Created branch** `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` `from main`.
2. **Bumped fastjson 2.8.0 → 2.9.4** in `requirements.txt` (the fixed release within the current major version), and added a changelog entry under Unreleased.
3. **Ran CI** on the branch — run `ci-0001` **passed** (commit `18e97f5b17`).
4. **Opened PR #101** against `main`: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101 — and explicitly requested **alex** as reviewer after the initial PR creation returned an empty reviewer list (now confirmed as `["alex"]`).

The PR is open and awaiting alex's review; merging into main will need code-owner approval per policy.
